app.setup.title_default.why: Plain factual status line, matches System Settings register.

app.setup.title_failed.why: Hedged, reads distinct from the plain not-yet-on state.

app.setup.detail_default.s: Met bescherming aan kan een site je klik niet meer omleiden.
app.setup.detail_default.back: With protection on a site can no longer redirect your click.
app.setup.detail_default.why: States the one payoff plainly, no slogan.

app.setup.detail_failed.s: Safari gaf geen antwoord. Zet de extensie aan en de app merkt het vanzelf.
app.setup.detail_failed.back: Safari gave no answer. Turn on the extension and the app notices it on its own.
app.setup.detail_failed.why: No error code, reassures no need to come back and check.

app.setup.open_button.why: Names the exact action; works verbatim on both screens.

app.welcome.heading.why: The one place allowed a warmer register; keeps the product name.

app.welcome.feature.invisible_layers.tit.why: Concrete noun naming the trick, no marketing language.

app.welcome.feature.invisible_layers.det.s: Een onzichtbare laag vangt je klik op en stuurt hem ergens anders heen.
app.welcome.feature.invisible_layers.det.back: An invisible layer catches your click and sends it somewhere else.
app.welcome.feature.invisible_layers.det.why: Describes what the person would experience, not the mechanism.

app.welcome.feature.swapped_links.title.why: Concrete two-word tag matching the icon.

app.welcome.feature.swapped_links.detail.s: Sommige pagina's veranderen waar een link heen gaat net voor je loslaat.
app.welcome.feature.swapped_links.detail.back: Some pages change where a link goes just before you let go.
app.welcome.feature.swapped_links.detail.why: Names the exact moment the switch happens, from the person's side.

app.welcome.feature.uninvited_windows.ti.why: Plain noun tag for the pop-up/new-tab trick.

app.welcome.feature.uninvited_windows.de.s: Met bescherming aan opent een nieuw tabblad alleen waar je zelf op klikte.
app.welcome.feature.uninvited_windows.de.back: With protection on a new tab only opens where you clicked yourself.
app.welcome.feature.uninvited_windows.de.why: Framed as a promise, not a description of the trick's mechanics.

app.welcome.feature.every_destination.ti.why: Names the rule-list feature, matches the vocabulary term destination.

app.welcome.feature.every_destination.de.s: Elke bestemming krijgt een regel: toestaan of blokkeren, hier of overal.
app.welcome.feature.every_destination.de.back: Every destination gets a rule: allow or block, here or everywhere.
app.welcome.feature.every_destination.de.why: Concrete, mirrors the actual review options in the app.

app.welcome.feature.one_site_at_a_time.d.s: Druk op de Undirect-knop in Safari om die site te beveiligen.
app.welcome.feature.one_site_at_a_time.d.back: Press the Undirect button in Safari to protect that site.
app.welcome.feature.one_site_at_a_time.d.why: Concrete action, ties to the toolbar-button vocabulary term.

app.nav.guarded_sites.why: Compact term for guarded site, fits a narrow sidebar column.

app.nav.settings.why: Apple's own Dutch term for this screen, not a synonym.

app.nav.app_title.why: Proper noun, left untranslated like any other app's own name.

app.rules.grouping.everywhere.why: Matches the scope vocabulary term, contrasts with Per site.

app.rules.grouping.by_site.why: Clear opposite of Overal when the two sit side by side.

app.rules.empty_no_app.title.why: A wiring state, kept distinct from the empty-rules content state.

app.rules.empty_no_app.detail.s: Open een pagina in Safari en dit vult zich vanzelf.
app.rules.empty_no_app.detail.back: Open a page in Safari and this fills itself in on its own.
app.rules.empty_no_app.detail.why: Simple fix, no setting to change.

app.rules.empty_no_rules.title.why: Short content-empty state, contrasts with the wiring state above.

app.rules.empty_no_rules.detail.s: Pas als je kiest, verschijnt hier een regel.
app.rules.empty_no_rules.detail.back: Only once you choose does a rule appear here.
app.rules.empty_no_rules.detail.why: Explains the trigger: a decision, not merely being seen.

app.rules.footer.lifetime_count.why: Single cumulative total; Dutch plural noun form for the count.

app.rules.row.state_blocked.why: One-word status, pairs cleanly with Toegestaan.

app.rules.row.action_allow.why: Imperative verb, distinct from the state word Toegestaan.

app.rules.row.help_tooltip.why: Short hover tooltip naming what the control does.

app.rules.row.use_default.why: Names clearing the rule back to the default policy.

app.watched.empty.title.why: Plain statement of the no-sites-yet state.

app.watched.empty.detail.s: Druk op de Undirect-knop in Safari terwijl je op een lastige site bent.
app.watched.empty.detail.back: Press the Undirect button in Safari while you're on a troublesome site.
app.watched.empty.detail.why: Concrete instruction naming the toolbar-button mechanism.

app.watched.footer.s: Nieuwe sites voeg je toe via de knop in Safari's werkbalk.
app.watched.footer.back: You add new sites via the button in Safari's toolbar.
app.watched.footer.why: Reminds the list only grows from the toolbar, not this screen.

app.watched.row.guarded_badge.why: Read-only status word, consistent with the guarded-site term.

app.watched.row.stop_button.why: Short imperative verb fit for a trailing row button.

app.watched.row.stop_tooltip.s: Zet bescherming voor deze site uit
app.watched.row.stop_tooltip.back: Turns off protection for this site
app.watched.row.stop_tooltip.why: Describes the action under the pointer.

app.settings.guard_toggle.why: The master-switch noun, reused as the concept name throughout.

app.settings.state_on.why: Generic on-state, reused across more than one setting row.

app.settings.mode_watched.why: Described from the person's own point of view, per the brief.

app.settings.banner_toggle.why: Matches the vocabulary term note in the page.

app.settings.policy_heading.why: Names the default-policy concept, matches vocabulary term.

app.settings.policy_block.why: Short imperative picker option, consistent with the verb elsewhere.

ext.meta.name.why: Brand name, left untranslated in the extension listing.

ext.meta.description.s: Voorkomt dat pagina's je klik gebruiken om je ongevraagd ergens anders heen te sturen.
ext.meta.description.back: Prevents pages from using your click to send you somewhere else uninvited.
ext.meta.description.why: One sentence for a reader who has never used the extension.

ext.meta.app_title.why: Fallback display name, just the product's own name.

ext.toolbar.tooltip_on.why: States the current active state as a system tooltip.

ext.toolbar.tooltip_off.s: Bescherming uit, klik om aan te zetten
ext.toolbar.tooltip_off.back: Protection off, click to turn on
ext.toolbar.tooltip_off.why: Doubles as the call to action per the brief.

ext.toolbar.tooltip_no_site.why: Brief explanation for a tab with no website.

ext.popup.no_site_title.why: Short empty-state headline for a blank tab or Start Page.

ext.popup.no_site_body.s: Open een website en druk hier op de knop.
ext.popup.no_site_body.back: Open a website and press the button here.
ext.popup.no_site_body.why: Keeps 'hier' pointed at the button itself, per the brief's note.

ext.popup.watch_switch_label.s: Bescherming voor deze site aan of uit zetten
ext.popup.watch_switch_label.back: Turn protection for this site on or off
ext.popup.watch_switch_label.why: Full context for a screen-reader user with no visual row.

ext.popup.watch_unknown.why: Plain reason the switch is disabled.

ext.popup.watch_everywhere_mode.back: Already switched on everywhere in Settings
ext.popup.watch_everywhere_mode.why: Points to where the overriding setting actually lives.

ext.popup.watch_master_off.why: Clarifies this is the master switch, not this one site.

ext.popup.watch_on.s: Aan. Uitzetten laadt de pagina opnieuw.
ext.popup.watch_on.back: On. Turning it off reloads the page.
ext.popup.watch_on.why: Confirms state, then warns of the reload, in two short clauses.

ext.popup.watch_off.s: Uit. Aanzetten laadt de pagina opnieuw.
ext.popup.watch_off.back: Off. Turning it on reloads the page.
ext.popup.watch_off.why: Mirrors watch_on's sentence shape, per the brief's pairing note.

ext.popup.page_heading.why: Names the section listing this one tab's own attempts.

ext.popup.page_off.s: Niets bijgehouden, bescherming staat hier uit.
ext.popup.page_off.back: Nothing tracked, protection is off here.
ext.popup.page_off.why: Dead key as of 2026-09-22; matches the voice of the other page states.

ext.popup.page_quiet.s: Deze pagina heeft nog niets geprobeerd.
ext.popup.page_quiet.back: This page hasn't tried anything yet.
ext.popup.page_quiet.why: Plain statement that nothing has happened so far.

ext.popup.page_empty.s: Er is nog niets om te tonen.
ext.popup.page_empty.why: Dead key; a near-synonym of page_quiet, per the brief's note.

ext.popup.stopped_one.why: Badge count; Dutch predicate participle is invariant for singular.

ext.popup.stopped_other.why: Plural case; same surface form since the participle doesn't inflect.

ext.popup.seen_one.why: Total recorded, singular noun form, distinct from stopped.

ext.popup.seen_other.why: Plural noun form, paired with seen_one.

ext.popup.tries_one.why: Terse fragment for concatenation; 'keer' takes no plural marker.

ext.popup.tries_other.why: Same surface form as tries_one, since Dutch 'keer' is invariant.

ext.state.blocked.why: Consistent with the app-side term; combines with a scope fragment.

ext.state.allowed.why: Consistent opposite pair, same combination requirement.

ext.state.removed.why: Distinct from allow/block since there's no destination to rule on.

ext.scope.here.why: Fragment composed after a verdict word, e.g. 'Geblokkeerd op deze site'.

ext.scope.everywhere.why: One-word fragment following the verdict word.

ext.scope.default.why: Fragment following the verdict word, e.g. 'Geblokkeerd standaard'.

ext.action.allow_here.why: Unambiguous option, distinct from the everywhere variant.

ext.popup.policy_heading.why: Same concept and wording as the app settings screen's heading.

ext.popup.bridge_warning.s: Deze pagina's beveiliging blokkeert een deel van de bescherming hier.
ext.popup.bridge_warning.back: This page's security blocks part of the protection here.
ext.popup.bridge_warning.why: Frames it as this page's own limitation, not a bug.

ext.kind.click_catcher.why: Terse noun-phrase tag matching its sibling kind tags.

ext.kind.overlay.why: Reuses the same term as the welcome-screen feature row.

ext.kind.synthetic_click.why: Names a script-generated click, not a real press.

ext.kind.window_open.why: Standard Dutch term for the window the page's own script opened.

ext.kind.form_submit.why: Names the mechanism tersely, matching sibling tags.

ext.kind.href_swap.why: Names the destination-swap trick as a short tag.

ext.kind.back_hijack.why: Ties the tag to the back-navigation moment specifically.

ext.kind.network_rule.why: Names the earliest, network-level block distinctly.

ext.reason.way_back.why: Explains the round-trip signal that allowed this redirect.

ext.reason.sized.why: Explains the deliberate-size signal for this window.

ext.reason.took_press.why: Terse core-hijack reason, fits the tight character budget.

ext.reason.default_allow.why: Ties directly to the default-policy vocabulary term.

ext.reason.own_code.why: Explains the site's own code vouching for the window.

ext.popup.rules_link.why: Matches the vocabulary term rule, reused across three spots.

ext.popup.back_link.why: Names the main per-page view the back button returns to.

ext.rules.everywhere_heading.why: Consistent with the app's equivalent grouping label.

ext.rules.by_site_heading.why: Consistent with the app's equivalent grouping label.

ext.rules.empty.why: Terse list placeholder, reuses the same term as elsewhere.

ext.action.allow.why: Consistent verb, scope already fixed by the section it's in.

ext.action.clear.why: Same action as app.rules.row.use_default, phrased consistently.

ext.popup.settings_heading.why: Apple's own term, reused as the popup's own settings screen.

ext.settings.guard_label.why: Matches the master-switch term used in the container app.

ext.settings.banner_toggle.why: Compact one-word compound to fit the popup's tighter budget.

ext.action.report.why: Names opening the pre-filled issue report, nothing sent automatically.
